notes: All three assigned rows provide the identical description naming process versus outcome accountability, and all locate replication Studies 1 & 2 (Meta) on p.120. Each is therefore matched independently to that explicitly named two-experiment contrast; no distinct comparison is inferred from audit_id, row order, or numbers. The p.120 process-versus-no-accountability contrast (d=-0.04, p=.77) and outcome-versus-no-accountability contrast (d=0.03, p=.82) are different comparisons, not assigned by row order. The process-versus-outcome analysis adding the original study (d=-0.30, p=.21) is also excluded because the locator specifies only Studies 1 & 2. Printed metric is d; no further standardisation identity is assumed and no conversion is performed. Analytic N for the selected two-condition contrast is not explicitly supplied. The 353 on p.121 covers all THREE corresponding conditions across both experiments (including no-accountability), not this two-condition contrast. Experiment 1 reports 205 final participants across four conditions and 154 across the three replication conditions; Experiment 2 reports 199 across three conditions. No explicit complete final group counts supporting a sum for the target contrast are printed in the supplied article; no N is derived from df, plot points, manipulation-check denominators, or subtraction. Experiment 1 excludes 15 (5 refusal to be videotaped, 4 wrong questionnaire, 2 uninterpretable answer, 3 suspicious, 1 premature termination); eight nonstudents never entered its original sample. Experiment 2 excludes 16 (10 technical problems, 3 procedure mistakes, 3 disbelief/quit); ten ineligible people never entered its original sample. Original side, reported_success, and unassigned replication fields are placeholders only and were not evaluated.
